Name: Clint sells additional supplies
Author: sadnumbme
Description:
Clint sells additional supplies. Clint increases what he sells based on friendship and skill levels. You will get a letter with gift each time he adds a new item. Price is configurable.
Charcoal Kiln //Clint friendship level 4 & foraging level 2
Copper Bar // Clint friendship level 2
Crystalarium // Clint friendship level 10 & mining level 9
Furance // Clint friendship level 4
Gold Bar // Clint friendship level 6 & mining level 7
Iridium Bar // Clint friendship level 8 & mining level 8
Iridium Ore // Clint friendship level 8 & mining level 8
Iron bar // Clint friendship level 4 & mining level 4
Lighting Rod // Clint friendship level 6 & foraging level 6
Marble // Clint friendship level 4 & mining level 4 (Added with V1.5)
Radioactive Bar // Clint friendship level 10 & mining level 10
Radioactive Ore // Clint friendship level 10 & mining level 10

As of V1.5 you can adjust the price of the coal, copper ore, iron ore and gold ore for both year 1 and year 2.  Clint will now buy some machines from you, but don't expect a decent price. 

[b]Translations[/b]
Translations are welcome. Please let me know and link the translation to this mod.
[b]Insulation[/b]
1. Download and Install the Latest Version of SMAPI.﻿﻿
2. Download and Extract Content Patcher mod into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
3. Download and Extract Generic Mod Config Menu mod into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.﻿ (optional
but recommended)
4. Download and Extract [b]Clint sells additional supplies[/b] into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.﻿﻿﻿
5. Launch Stardew Valley. To enable the settings you want, click the cog wheel on the bottom left of the
Stardew Valley title screen. 

If you like this mod, please endorse it and check out my other mods.
